text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 4532 — service-egress errors detected in us-west-2. Pager run, now resolved. Root cause still under investigation. Please schedule postmortem and assign facilitator. Incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4532 :warning:

Priya: Thanks — incident bot. Quick ask: who can facilitate the postmortem? I can take notes but can't facilitate the meeting the next two days.

Ben: I can facilitate on Friday afternoon (PST). Happy to run the agenda + timeline.

Marta: Friday works for me too. What time were you thinking? We should include runtime, infra, and product PM (Ava)

Eli: Heads up, I have a customer call at 2pm PST on Friday. Prefer 11am or 4pm. Also flagging that support should be there to confirm customer impact timeline.

Priya: Preference poll: 11:00am PST Fri (option A) or 4:00pm PST Fri (option B). If neither, next available is Monday morning.

Jo: I can do 11am. Also volunteering to be backup facilitator if Ben can't make it last-minute.

Ben: Cool — I'll facilitate if 11am works. I'll prep the timeline + RCA draft.

Sam: 11am works. I'll bring any logs and the KV cache dump snippets.

Ava: I'll attend for product and bring a short customer-impact summary. Note: legal might want to be looped but not necessary for the PM review.

Priya: Great. Action items for scheduling: 
- Ben: facilitate meeting and own agenda doc (doc owner)
- Priya: schedule meeting invite + create Google doc for postmortem (link placeholder)
- Jo: backup facilitator and capture action items during meeting
- Sam: attach logs and reproduction steps to the doc before meeting
- Eli: confirm customer-visible window and prepare the support timeline

Marta: Can we add a pre-read? Small timeline + symptoms + immediate mitigations, 1 pager. Helps keep the meeting <45m.

Ben: Agreed. I'll draft a 1-page pre-read in the postmortem doc by Thu EOD. Priya — can you set the invite for 11:00am PST Fri and include Zoom link + calendar?

Priya: Done — invite sent to attendees: Ben, Jo, Sam, Ava, Marta, Eli, Priya. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/999999999?pwd=postmortem. Calendar event ID: 179123PM1. Doc link: https://docs.redwood.com/pm/INC-4532-postmortem (placeholder) :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Reminder: include severity classification, customer impact, timeline, root cause, action items, and owners in postmortem doc. Use template: https://docs.redwood.com/templates/postmortem-template

Eli: One more ask: assign an owner for the deployment rollback verification. I can take that if needed — will add steps to the doc.

Ben: Adding action owners inline in doc. For tracking, create a JIRA epic for remediation. Priya — can you create INC-4532-REMED and link in the doc?

Priya: Created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4532-REMED. I'll link it. ETA for owners to add tasks is EOD Mon.

Jo: Small note on attendees — we should cc infra-ops and runtime-config to the invite so they can chime in asynchronously if they're blocked.

Ava: Agree. Also will prepare the customer impact blurb and send to product-ops for any legal review flags.

Sam: For meeting facilitation — Ben, if you want a quick dry run of the timeline, ping me 30m before. I can walk through logs.

Ben: Thanks. I'll do that. Final attendee list pinned in invite: Ben (facilitator), Jo (backup), Priya (scribe/org), Sam (runtime), Eli (support), Ava (product), Marta (infra).

incident-bot: Postmortem meeting scheduled: Fri 11:00am PST. Thread will be used to capture any pre-meeting updates. Reminder scheduled 1h before.

Priya: Quick followup — Ben, is there any extra data you need from oncall to draft RCA? If so, tag me and I'll pull it.

Ben: Logs + full proxy error traces and the cache snapshot are enough. Sam already volunteered to attach. If anything else, I'll ask.

Marta: I'll prepare a proposed remediation plan for the meeting (1-2 options + risk/cost). Will add to the doc by Fri 9am PST.

Ava: Thanks all. I'll post the customer impact blurb in the doc tonight for visibility.

Priya: Closing loop — meeting invite confirmed, pre-read expected Thu EOD, postmortem doc + JIRA linked. If anyone can't make it, please add comments in the doc or propose a delegate.

Ben: Thanks team. See you Fri 11am.

Jo: :thumbsup:
